# Getting help

kelve has one maintainer, so help is given when there's time for it.

- What kelve is, and how it works: [the docs](../docs/README.md).
- Questions and ideas: [Discussions](https://github.com/kelve-ai/kelve/discussions).
- Something broken: [open an issue](https://github.com/kelve-ai/kelve/issues/new/choose).
- A security problem: [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), privately.
